study.question: Can replacing Shannon entropy by collision-derived order-2 entropy preserve the stronger direct_lifted utility at lower cost, after sparse exact counting removes the unused identity-by-context workspace?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g2-r0027-overlap_zero attained AUC0.6303146364, logloss0.1927319603, train619.702s and inference21.883s, versus contemporary full AUC0.6300264948/train630.142s/inference22.291s; concentration was AUC0.630197821 and its dense execution control trained slightly faster, so neither concentration necessity nor reproducible execution savings was established. The full anchor g1-r0020-direct_lifted is AUC0.6304316804. Context coarsening (g2-r0025-action_context) and width8 replacement (g2-r0026-compact_slice8) lost utility. Mechanism hypothesis: within unchanged fine contexts, the already supplied collision C=sum p^2 plus count may carry enough dispersion information that replacing every recurrence Shannon H by H2=-log(C) loses little utility. This removes higher-distribution information and run-level xlogx work, without reducing embedding width or context resolution. A sparse exact Shannon control separates this representation change from compact execution. This is provisional, not a novelty or sufficiency claim.

nearest_work.difference: Direct parent omits overlap but retains BxLx16 run/context counts and exact Shannon summaries. Both new variants replace that workspace with nested X and (X,Y) runs from one composite sort, using BxL storage; only candidate replaces all recurrence Shannon coordinates with collision-derived H2.

That replacement changed cross-context overlap G into sqrt(C_i*C_j), keeping Shannon summaries. Its zero control was at least as promising in one run. Here overlap stays zero and the intervention tests Shannon information beyond collision in identity, context and conditional-repeat blocks.

study.proposed_difference: Composite key64*(category*brand_vocab+brand)+16*match_group+context sorts pair/group before context. Nested run IDs yield joint-pair and pair/context masses in BxL; group and conditional sums use only Bx4 and Bx64. No BxLx16 recurrence array or Gram products occurs in either new forward. exact_sparse keeps empirical Shannon H. collision_sparse replaces all six distinct entropy families (category,brand,pair,context,pair-context,conditional pair) by masked -log(C), while count and C coordinates, feature widths28/28/192 and all parameters remain equal. Higher entropy information is discarded; H2 is redundant with C, so active representational rank is lower despite matched parameter count. Standard entropy/collision mathematics and sparse counting are inherited ideas; no verified new-to-literature claim. A witness n6 counts(3,3) versus(4,1,1) has equal collision1/2 but different Shannon entropy, providing an explicit information-loss counterexample.
predictions: Correctness gate: exact_sparse blocks identity/context/repeat agree with full reference and independent event-equality oracle on <=8 diagnostic rows within2e-6, zero overlap exactly; nested counts conserve complete-pair support exactly. Both variants produce finite logits and correct empty/missing/padded behavior.

Mechanism gate: collision_sparse changes only entropy coordinate slots; count and collision differences vs exact_sparse are <=2e-6. H2 is nonnegative, zero for empty distributions, and <=Shannon within2e-6. Equal-C/different-Shannon synthetic witness must show discarded information.

Prospective utility retention: candidate AUC >=0.6299316803980214 (fixed anchor minus0.0005), and candidate minus contemporary exact_sparse AUC >=-0.0005; logloss increase <=0.0002 against both frozen anchor0.19269404064402526 and exact_sparse. These exploratory gates are not statistical equivalence tests.

Efficiency requires >=5% lower mean measured train time or whole-validation inference time under repeated matched host conditions vs the selected full reference; report p50/p95, parameters, memory, and wall time. Candidate-vs-exact_sparse isolates entropy substitution. A one-run timing decrease or sparse source shape alone is insufficient.

No parameter reduction is predicted: allocation should remain17253123 for the same meta. Peak GPU memory may remain dominated by embedding optimizer state; no numerical memory or cost improvement is assumed.
falsifiers: Any exact-control oracle/conservation/invariance error >2e-6, nonfinite output, support violation or changed nonentropy coordinate invalidates implementation attribution; do not interpret it as scientific evidence against collision sufficiency.
